important_warning: These are approximate values digitized from a raster rendering of the published figure. They are not an author-provided raw data table and should normally be quoted with only 2-3 significant digits.

source.author_repository_note: No XXZ Figure 5 raw point table was found in the paper's public repository during this comparison work.

paper_text_locations.hierarchy_definition: Eq. (5): rho^(m) acts on m physical lattice sites and the hierarchy is kept through rho^(n).
paper_text_locations.figure_definition: Figure 5 caption: the curves are shown for various sizes n and bond dimensions D.
paper_text_locations.error_definition: Text immediately before Figure 5: Delta E_MPS/TTN^relax(n,D) := E_TI - E_MPS/TTN^relax(n,D).

paper_series.visual_style: green star markers with a green dotted curve

x_axis.name: n
x_axis.definition: number of physical spin sites in the largest uncompressed RDM rho^(n) before compression

digitization_method.summary: The PDF page was rendered at 720 dpi. Axis tick centers were detected from the raster, the D=6 green pixels were selected by RGB distance, and marker centers or narrow curve slices were converted through the fitted log-axis calibration.

x_pixel_calibration.note: This tick fit replaces the earlier incorrect assumption that the right plot edge represented n=70. That assumption shifted several requested x positions to the right.

digitization_method.uncertainty_interpretation: The low/high fields estimate raster-reading uncertainty from marker extent, line thickness, antialiasing, and local sampling. They are not statistical error bars reported by the authors.

central_value_policy.marker_center: Use the center of the visible D=6 star or of the coincident early-hierarchy marker.
central_value_policy.curve_slice: Use the center of a narrow vertical slice through the dotted D=6 curve when the requested n is not a marker location.
central_value_policy.log_interpolation: For n=30 and n=32, interpolate in log(n)-log(error) between the clearly identified n=28 and n=34 D=6 markers.

digitized_d6_samples.note: The green D=6 series is overplotted by the black LTI marker here; the common marker center was used.
The central value was selected from the marker geometry rather than the median of all colored pixels, because the star arms bias the raw pixel median.
Interpolation between the neighboring marker centers was used because a direct narrow slice is contaminated by the n=46 star arm.
The raster marker center is slightly non-monotone relative to neighboring points; do not over-interpret this within the digitization range.

comparison_mapping_guidance.paper_n: Always interpret the paper's n as a count of physical spin sites.

existing_local_real_u1_runner.physical_blocking: two physical spins per SDP site
existing_local_real_u1_runner.evidence: The runner writes this formula directly into every result JSON.

collaborator_table_alternative.required_confirmation: Before using this alternative mapping, verify from the collaborator's exact code snapshot whether one SDP site is one physical spin or a two-spin blocked cell.

superseded_local_artifacts.reason: It used an incorrect horizontal calibration and mixed star-marker arms into the n=10 interpolation.
Its paper n=20 value approximately equals the corrected n=22 value, revealing the horizontal-coordinate shift. Its n=30 value is likewise shifted toward later points.
Its paper n=20 and n=30 comparison values predate the corrected x-axis tick calibration. Use this JSON for paper data.

agent_usage_rules: Use digitized_d6_samples as the authoritative local paper D=6 data source.
Do not label these values as author raw data.
Use at most 2-3 significant digits in prose or figures.
Propagate digitization_low and digitization_high as a visual reading band when plotting.
Compare absolute error to absolute error; do not divide by the exact energy unless explicitly making a separate relative-error plot.
Resolve the factor-of-two blocking convention from the exact run code before placing collaborator points on the paper n axis.
Treat solver clean/status/certificate metadata separately from the paper digitization; a low plotted error is not by itself a rigorous certificate.
